bear.point: EBITDA margin fell 0.9 pp YoY to 18.9%, indicating rising costs erode profit growth.
Debt/equity rose to 0.45 from 0.41, increasing leverage and financial risk.
Analysts flagged underlying ARPU pressure, suggesting connectivity revenue quality is weakening.
New energy manufacturing faces China competition, threatening future margin expansion potential.

bull.point: PAT reached Rs.30,000 Crores, up 34% YoY, demonstrating significant bottom-line acceleration.
EBITDA hit Rs.62,409 Crores, up 24% YoY, showing strong operational profitability growth.
5G subscribers reached 300 million, securing a dominant market position in next-gen connectivity.
RJIL EBITDA margin expanded 200 bps to 58.1%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
